dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ahh, this breeze feels great! I'll just rest here for a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Ooh, good timing, {NICKNAME}! Come on, sit next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: This is probably the highest point in Mondstadt City. Look at that view! Beautiful, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: There's so many people in the square. Mmm... I can even see Margaret taking a walk down there...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *yawn* It's only on days off like this that I can just... gaze into the distance and zone out.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Usually, I'm either taking off from or landing here in a big hurry...

choices.text: Make sure you get enough rest, Amber.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well, I am a Knight of Favonius. Helping everyone who lives here is my duty.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: As long as I can help solve the issue, no matter what it is, I have an obligation to assist.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's our No. 1 Outrider for you.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh? Aw, stop it, you're making me blush. Lots of Knights and others from the Adventurers' Guild work as hard as I do, if not harder.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But I'll do all I can, the best I can, as long as it's for Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...Huh? Hang on, why's Margaret suddenly running off like that? She's shouting something, too.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Whoa, she's chasing someone. A thief, maybe?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You wait here, I'll go help her! We can't let someone like that get away!

choices.text: That means you're usually way overworked.
